snippet.title: Serious Sam Forever - Thebes - Luxor
snippet.description:
Forever Revive project presents the finalized "Thebes - Luxor" lvl. All bugs will be fixed in the future! Enjoy the video.

For people with extensive experience in Serious Engine 2 (or more) who want to help with the project's completion, please contact me!

Map made by: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198053768074/
